points.description: States that overloaded functions are differentiated by their function signature (i.e. their parameter lists: number, types or order of parameters), with the compiler choosing the one that best/closest matches the call.
points.partial_credit: Award about 2-3 marks if the answer only vaguely refers to the function call/arguments matching or to differing parameters without mentioning signature, or mentions only the compiler matching the call without saying what is compared.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the compiler tells them apart by signature, or by their parameters (number/types/order), in any wording. Part marks for vague answers, such as matching the call to a function without saying what is compared. Give no marks for unrelated ideas, such as differing only by return type or by function name alone.
